description: This is the main entry point for a Vue.js application. It imports essential modules such as Vue's createApp, Pinia for state management, the root component App, and the router configuration. It initializes the Vue app, applies plugins, and mounts the app to the DOM.

methods.name: app.use
methods.description: A method used to register plugins or middleware with the Vue application instance.

methods.name: app.mount
methods.description: Mounts the Vue application to a DOM element identified by the selector '#app'.
